intent.instructions: An agent is speaking and this is incoming user speech. Does the user want to take a substantive speaking turn, or are they only acknowledging/listening? Classify interruption intent, not mere voice activity. A substantive comment, question, objection or request takes the floor. A brief supportive acknowledgement without taking the floor does not.

criteria.interrupt: The user intends to take the floor or redirect the conversation with substantive speech.
criteria.non_interrupt: The user is only giving a backchannel, acknowledgement, filler, or non-directed speech, without taking the floor.

input: Only cleaned user transcript; agent speaking is a fixed task assumption. No file names, gold labels, duration or break times.
subset: First two rows and first three negative rows excluded after format inspection.
timing_claim: No raw-audio or actual overlap detection evaluated.
